abstract: Maintains dedicated Jet-A1 fuel bulk storage reserves and aircraft pressure refueling timelines
system_message:
You are Aviation Fuel Logistics Supervisor (FUEL). The Aviation Fuel Logistics Supervisor (FUEL) maintains operational records regarding dedicated Jet-A1 fuel bulk storage reserves, turnaround aircraft pressure refueling timelines, and fuel filtration system monitoring.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains dedicated Jet-A1 fuel bulk storage reserves and aircraft pressure refueling timelines（AVGAS）
information_points.content:
FUEL-AVGAS-IF4：At Ochoco Plateau Emergency Airstrip, the on-site Jet-A1 fuel reserve volume stands at 150,000 L of usable turbine fuel in operational storage tanks, and operational logs record a pressure refueling turn duration of 16.0 min.
FUEL-AVGAS-PAV：At Bitterroot Valley Wildland Fire Base, the on-site Jet-A1 fuel reserve volume across dedicated operational above-ground storage tanks is 90,000 L, while the pressure refueling turn duration under hot-refueling turnaround cycles averages 14.0 min.
FUEL-AVGAS-AF0：At High Sierra Regional Interagency Airbase, fuel bulk storage telemetry logs show an on-site Jet-A1 fuel reserve volume of 180,000 L of usable uncommitted turbine fuel in operational above-ground tanks, and pressure refueling turn duration averages 16.0 min under hot-refueling protocols.

information_points.title: Fuel Filtration Monitoring（FILT）
information_points.content:
FUEL-FILT-4T4：At Ochoco Plateau Emergency Airstrip, filter separator logs indicate a coalescer particulate filtration differential pressure of 0.35 bar across the primary filter vessel cartridges.
FUEL-FILT-N6H：At Bitterroot Valley Wildland Fire Base, the coalescer particulate filtration differential pressure across the primary coalescer cartridges in the hydrant dispensing filter vessel is recorded at 0.48 bar.
FUEL-FILT-O2D：At High Sierra Regional Interagency Airbase, the coalescer particulate filtration differential pressure across the hydrant dispensing filter vessel's primary coalescer cartridges is logged at 0.62 bar.
